_comment: Raftel AE — Alibaba Cloud ECS configuration template. Copy to config.json and fill in your account details.
_paper_spec: Paper §7.1: 8 vCPU / 32 GB RAM / 10 Gbps private network, 1 replica per instance, Ubuntu 20.04 x86-64, Intel SGX hardware enclave required.
_region_note: e.g. cn-hangzhou or cn-shanghai. All instances must be in the same region/VPC for 10 Gbps private networking.
_instance_type_note: SGX-capable, 8 vCPU / 32 GB. g7t series supports Intel SGX2 (TDX vTPM). Verify availability in your region: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/doc-detail/108490.htm. Alternative with SGX1: ecs.c7t.2xlarge (8 vCPU / 16 GB, check if memory is sufficient).
_instance_count_note: Default 7 for quick/smoke runs. For full paper-scale reproduction: fig3 needs up to 97 (f=32, 3f+1 replicas), fig4 up to 49 (f=16), fig6 needs 25 (f=8). Use ./ae cloud up --count N to override at runtime.
_image_note: Ubuntu 20.04 LTS x86-64. Find the latest image ID for your region: aliyun ecs DescribeImages --RegionId YOUR_REGION --OSType linux --Architecture x86_64 | grep ubuntu_20
_security_group_note: Must allow: SSH (22) from coordinator, and all TCP between instances in the VPC (for replica-to-replica communication on ports 8760-8860).
_key_pair_note: The corresponding private key must be available at ./TShard on the coordinator machine (not committed to git).
_vswitch_note: All instances should use the same vswitch (same availability zone) to guarantee 10 Gbps private bandwidth between them.
